03 / System architecture

One mission. Four systems.

Hardware and software, side by side. Eight one-page diagrams show the functions, interfaces and responsibilities of each element.

Download all 8 pages · PDF ↓
Read the architecture

Blue lines carry data; dashed amber lines are commands or inhibits; rose lines carry power or gas supply; green lines show material or mechanical interfaces. Each page includes its interface contract, lifecycle and source basis.

These are proposed functional allocations. The capsule computer boundary, propulsion selection, sample-transfer chain and component-level mass/power closure remain open design trades.

Sources and architecture boundaries

FDS-001 Rev09 specification · Integration and open design trades · Benner-derived probe requirements BIO-P01–10 · Diagram block and connection data.

The cold-gas module performs separation, retroburn alignment and heat-shield entry alignment before jettison. The capsule then enters passively. The carrier releases independent probes and retains its own status/energy path; probe science is not assumed to require a carrier relay.
